presentation.label: MUTE LATCH
presentation.summary: Hold TEMPO while choosing tracks in PREP MUTES and the mutes wait for the pattern's first step.
presentation.overview: PREP MUTES normally mutes the chosen tracks the moment FUNC is let go. With Mute Latch, holding TEMPO while you choose the tracks parks the choice instead: let go of every key and the mutes switch at the next pass of the pattern's first step, so both hands are free for a synth or effects in the meantime. Without TEMPO held, PREP MUTES works exactly as before.
highlights: Parks the PREP MUTES choice until the pattern starts again
Leaves the stock gesture untouched unless TEMPO is held
Takes no sequencer hook: it follows the instrument's own step position
usage: Play a pattern, hold FUNC, hold TEMPO and press the TRIG keys of the tracks to switch, then let go of all keys; the tracks switch at the next first step.

access.location: PREP MUTES (FUNC held, with the permanent mute mode on)
steps: Hold FUNC to open PREP MUTES.
Hold TEMPO and press the TRIG keys of the tracks to switch; press a key again to take the track back out.
Let go of TEMPO, the TRIG keys and FUNC. The tracks switch when the pattern next reaches its first step.

limitations: Not tested on a unit, and the module itself has not run in an emulator. The step position, pattern pointer, mute toggle and view stack were observed on the stock OS 1.17 in a ColdFire-only emulator; see TESTING.md.
Works while the sequencer plays; when it is stopped PREP MUTES keeps its stock behaviour.
With Scale per track the longest track's wrap ends the pattern.
Switches on the first UI tick (about 30 Hz) after the pattern wraps, not sample-accurately.
The stock result of FUNC+TEMPO is not checked yet; the module does not consume the key.

load.conditions: Measure with every track playing, parameters modulated and the mod at its heaviest setting.
